**Microsoft FY2024 gross margin (fiscal year ended June 30, 2024)**

| Item | FY2024 | FY2023 |
|---|---|---|
| Revenue | $245,122M [DOC-1] | $211,915M [DOC-1] |
| Cost of revenue | $74,114M [DOC-1] | $65,863M [DOC-1] |
| **Gross margin (gross profit)** | **$171,008M** | $146,052M |
| **Gross margin %** | **69.8%** | 68.9% |

Calculation: $245,122M − $74,114M = $171,008M; $171,008M ÷ $245,122M = 69.76% [DOC-1].

Comparability note: Both periods are 12-month fiscal years ended June 30 and are drawn from the same FY2024 10-K income statement, with FY2023 presented as the prior-year comparative on a consistent basis [DOC-1]. No divestiture, spinoff, or reporting-basis change is indicated in the excerpt, so the year-over-year figures are directly comparable. (Note that the term "gross margin" is used here for the consolidated company; the excerpt does not provide segment-level detail.)

ANSWER: $171,008 million gross profit, or approximately 69.8% of revenue
